components_and_sections.name: KineticHero
components_and_sections.description: Bold masked typography reveal with real-time ping simulation, LEO satellite orbital status badge, dual CTA, and interactive multi-bearer telemetry card.

components_and_sections.name: EditorialRibbon
components_and_sections.description: Slow organic drift marquee ribbon showcasing verified maritime protocols: STARLINK MARITIME • ONEWEB ENTERPRISE • KVH TRACNET • IRIDIUM GMDSS • FLEETBROADBAND 250/500 • BONDED SD-WAN • ZERO LATENCY SPIKES

components_and_sections.name: ServicesMatrix
components_and_sections.description: Interactive showcase of the 5 core satcom systems (Starlink, OneWeb, KVH, Iridium Certus, FleetBroadband) with latency meters, hardware dish specs, and use-case selectors.

components_and_sections.name: CoverageSimulator
components_and_sections.description: Interactive route & coverage selector across North Atlantic, Pacific, Indian Ocean, Arctic & Polar Passages showing active constellation handoffs and plan tiers.

components_and_sections.name: EngineerManifesto
components_and_sections.description: Numbered technical chapters (01 RF Topology, 02 Gyro-Stabilization, 03 SD-WAN Bonding, 04 SOLAS Compliance) by senior marine communications engineers.

components_and_sections.name: QuoteEnquiryForm
components_and_sections.description: Full fleet quote estimator storing data to FastAPI backend MongoDB with vessel type, current antenna setup, target bandwidth, and instant confirmation.

components_and_sections.name: SupportTicketModal
components_and_sections.description: Ticket dispatch system with priority levels (P1 Vessel Dead in Water to P4 General Inquiry), vessel call sign/IMO inputs, and real-time status tracker.

components_and_sections.name: AdminDashboard
components_and_sections.description: Tactical admin command view displaying all incoming quotes, support tickets, vessel fleet statuses, and backend enquiry exports.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration with customized dampening for ultra-slick momentum
micro_interactions: Hover glow on all tactical tech cards (radial gradient following cursor / subtle border-cyan glow)
Live ping indicator pulsating every 2.4s to emulate ping packet heartbeat (24ms latency)
Smooth tab transition on services matrix with active highlight border line
Animated progress bars on throughput and failover speed tests

accessibility_and_standards.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.8:1 for all muted text against #060A10 and #111C2B surfaces; 12:1 for primary headlines
accessibility_and_standards.interactive_targets: Minimum 44px height/touch target on all buttons, tabs, inputs, and selectors
accessibility_and_standards.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap animations with conditional reduced-motion checks or fallback to instant opacity transitions
accessibility_and_standards.testing_attributes: All inputs, buttons, filters, modal triggers, and status badges MUST include data-testid='...' in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent.template_rules: farm-ts with FastAPI backend in backend/ and React 19 in frontend/. Store enquiries & support tickets via /api/enquiries and /api/tickets in MongoDB with full mock fallback when backend is unreachable.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Dark mode by default in index.html (ensure class='dark' on html element). Import @fontsource-variable/sora and @fontsource-variable/dm-sans in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.branding: Brand Name: 'OCEAN BROADBAND' - Sub: Maritime Satellite & Orbital Communications. High-end, technical, authoritative, with live NOC aesthetic.
